studies.title: Registan — c. 1700
studies.caption: About 1700. Three madrasas face the open square at Samarkand.
studies.prompt: Eye-level diagonal from southwest Registan, Ulugh Beg west side, Sher Dor east opposite, Tilya Kori north with blue dome, coherent three-sided square and tiled portals, no fourth giant madrasa closing foreground.
